findings.simplificationBenefit: -~470 SLOC; removes a rule contradicting A-18.

findings.title: 49 orphan feat modules (~9.8k SLOC), many documented as implemented
findings.observed: No static or dynamic importer, no system.json entry (esmodules is index.js only), no pack/macro reference found by git grep; modules self-register only when their register function is called, which never happens. Clusters: (a) normalization+runtime pairs for families in feat addenda (skill, expanded skill, team, rebellion, second wind, weapon/armor riders, galaxy intrigue, unknown regions, force scoundrel, legacy clone, starship, sport hunter, area explosives runtime, mobility runtime, defense-avoidance runtime) = unwired-but-intended (UNIMPLEMENTED integration); (b) feat-stub-pack.js, feat-registry-ui.js, action-speed-feat-resolver.js, combat-feat-runtime-support.js, ability-meta-schema-default-hooks.js = legacy C candidates pending owner; also live-imported modules whose register function is never called (skill-feat-runtime-patches, team-feat-runtime-patches, action-speed-runtime-patches, rebellion-species-skill-feat-runtime-patches).
findings.intendedOwnership: Every feat family is either wired through registerFeatRuntime with a test or deleted.
findings.proposedSolution: Owner triage per cluster: wire (after F-FEA-001 dispatcher exists, with a test per family) or delete. Mark addenda statuses as NOT_REGISTERED until wired.
findings.alternatives: Move orphan modules to an archive directory outside scripts/ to prevent false implementation claims.
findings.regressionTests: CI check: every scripts/engine/feats/*.js is reachable from index.js or listed in an explicit archive allow-list.
findings.simplificationBenefit: Up to ~9.8k SLOC removed or made truthful
findings.risk: Wiring a family activates untested mechanics; deleting loses work in progress

findings.title: scripts/data/force-points.js: write-in-calculation functions with no callers; stale header
findings.observed: The 6 A-02 probe hits are un-awaited actor.setFlag calls inside getForcePointBase / hasPrestigeForcePointBonus (mutation inside a calculation, A-08), reachable only from calculateMaxForcePoints, updateActorForcePoints, initializeActorForcePoints and debug helpers, none of which has a caller. The live export is calculateMaxForcePointsForBuildPlan (read-only). Consequently the persistent prestige markers that FRC and progression read are never written by live code (CR-FRC-02).
findings.proposedSolution: Delete the uncalled functions (legacy C); owner decides whether persistence of base 6/7 is still intended and, if so, where the marker is written (progression finalizer).

findings.title: Dead actor writers in live utility modules; hardening.js imports ActorEngine only for them
findings.observed: ensureNpcStatblockSnapshot/rollbackNpcToStatblockSnapshot (hardening.js) call actor.setFlag/unsetFlag directly and ActorEngine.restoreFromSnapshot, but have no callers. lockActorMutations/snapshotActorBeforeMutation (mutation-safety.js) write actor flags directly and are reachable only via orphan hardening-init.js; the live importer (document-api-v13) uses only the pure validators. Removing the hardening.js writers removes its ActorEngine import, which is one of the four loops of the 18-file cycle (F-ACT-001).

findings.proposedSolution: Delete the two hardening.js functions and the ActorEngine import; delete mutation-safety write helpers (keep assertEmbeddedDocOwnership/validateItemForCreation). If NPC statblock snapshot/rollback is a wanted feature, re-home it in npc-followers via ActorEngine.
findings.regressionTests: Census: hardening.js has no import of actor-engine.js; cycle shrinks.
findings.simplificationBenefit: Breaks a cycle loop and removes A-02 bypass code.

findings.title: Unreferenced templates and stylesheets; two live apps' CSS never loaded
findings.observed: reachability.json: 43 unreferenced .hbs, 67 unreferenced .css. Sample of 14 templates verified by partial-name search across scripts/templates/system.json: no inbound reference (hits were class names or sibling files). combat-action-browser.css and gm-store-dashboard.css are not in system.json nor imported, so their live apps render without them. styles/shell/home-surface.css differs from loaded styles/system/home-surface.css.
findings.proposedSolution: Class F batch: verify dynamically composed partial names (grep `{{> (concat` / template string builders) then delete unreferenced files with their CSS; decide per F-UIS-007 whether the two app CSS files are added to system.json or deleted with the apps.
findings.regressionTests: A template-reference test that fails on new unreferenced .hbs.
findings.foundryAcceptance: Visual check of combat browser and store dashboard.
findings.risk: Low; dynamic partial names are the risk.

findings.title: Unreachable UI modules
findings.observed: 44 orphan/importers-only modules (~6.5k SLOC). Basename grep across scripts, templates, index.js, system.json and packs/*.db found no runtime reference (hits were word collisions or other unreachable modules). Clusters: dev diagnostics harnesses (class C or move to tools/), V1 bases (BaseAppV2 extends Application, CR-09; class C), UI components never wired (C), duplicate drop/modal/mobile helpers superseded by live ones (C).
findings.proposedSolution: Delete class C clusters in one change per cluster; move any wanted diagnostics into tools/ or tests/.
findings.alternatives: Keep diagnostics behind a dev flag with an importer.
findings.regressionTests: Census --check shows the files absent and no new orphans.

findings.title: Orphan vehicle modules
findings.observed: No static/dynamic importer, no template/pack/global reference (grep of scripts, templates, packs). The legacy normalizers are explicitly forbidden from running (tests assert absence of calls); modification-factory predates the sealed ledger planner; category registry is superseded by universal-vehicle-pack-registry. Several tests read normalizer source as text.
findings.proposedSolution: Class C deletion candidates after rewriting the text-reading pins (tests/phase2c_cp8_vehicle_import_source_fields.test.mjs, tests/phase2c-vehicle-live-roll-guard.test.mjs, tests/phase2c-vehicle-source-integrity-guards.test.mjs) to assert absence.
findings.regressionTests: Updated pins assert the files are gone and no runtime path calls them.

findings.title: Committed scratch scripts under tests/
findings.observed: Three _scratch*.mjs files are tracked in tests/. They are not test suites (CI runs only *.test.mjs) and nothing imports them.
findings.intendedOwnership: tests/ holds suites, helpers and fixtures.
findings.proposedSolution: Delete after the owner confirms they hold nothing needed.
findings.alternatives: Move to a gitignored scratch location.
